_note: Boundary text that replaces the secretariat's (parliament.gov.bd boundaryDetails, which still reads as the 2023 delimitation) for the seats the Election Commission redrew for the 13th parliament. scripts/sync.mjs applies these by seat slug. Source: the Commission's gazette of 11 December 2025 (notification 17.00.0000.025.22.090.24-875, the 300-seat list revised after the High Court kept Bagerhat and Gazipur on their 2023 lines), read from the gazette's page images, with its corrections of 24 December 2025 (no. 921: Faridpur-2 and -4 back on their 2023 lines, so no entry here) and 15 January 2026 (no. 66: the 24 December change to Pabna-1 and -2 cancelled, so they read as the 11 December gazette). Seats whose area the gazette left as in 2023 are not listed, even where it words them differently. The gazette's punctuation is normalised to the Commission's clause form the site parses: a comma between numbered items and between clauses it set on separate lines, Dhaka-14's two clauses marked (ক) and (খ), a ward range it wrote as '১ - ১০' written '১ থেকে ১০', and তেঁতুলিয়া spelled with its chandrabindu.
